stories.title: Jensen Huang’s image has been shattered. Could he be pushed out at Nvidia?
summary: Huang built Nvidia as a family business but after the co-founder had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, its board faces a difficult decisionFor more than 30 years, Jensen Huang has been the seemingly unshakable public face of Nvidia.
He co-founded the company as a young engineer in 1993 and oversaw its growth into a multitrillion dollar chipmaker and bellwether of the AI industry at large.He’s also made it a family business.
While not a company executive, his wife, Lori Mills Huang, leads the family foundation which, as of 2024, controls over 60m Nvidia shares.
